title: Functional Compression as Occam's Razor: Algebraic Complexity from Sensitivity Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2511.23152v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discovering discrete algebraic structures from data is a fundamental challenge in machine learning. We ask how continuous learning objectives can favor functional compression---representing data through shared algebraic composition rather than low-rank representations. We analyze the global optima of a canonical factorization model for algebraic completion (recovering finite binary operations) that demonstrated a preference for group operations. We measure algebraic complexity by the infimum of parameter sensitivity under exact reconstruction. We establish a universal complexity floor, whose attainment forces geometric alignment and unitarity of the latent representations. At the floor, input representations compose into the corresponding output representations; their reuse across the operation table propagates these local identities to enforce a globally shared algebraic structure. translated_abstract: 从数据中发现离散代数结构是机器学习中的一个根本性挑战。我们探讨连续的学习目标如何能够偏好功能压缩——即通过共享的代数组合而非低秩表示来表征数据。我们分析了用于代数补全（恢复有限二元运算）的规范分解模型的全局最优解，该模型已被证明对群运算具有偏好。我们以精确重构条件下参数敏感度的下确界来度量代数复杂度。我们建立了一个普适的复杂度下界（地板），达到该下界会迫使潜在表示具有几何对齐性与幺正性。在该下界处，输入表示组合成相应的输出表示；这些表示在整个运算表中的复用将局部恒等式传播开来，从而强制形成全局共享的代数结构。若下界未被达到，则存在一个正的间隙将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为代数补全分解模型建立了以参数敏感度下确界度量的普适复杂度下界，证明达到该下界会迫使潜在表示几何对齐且幺正，并使模型通过共享代数组合（功能压缩）而非低秩表示来学习到全局统一的代数结构。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes a universal complexity floor—the infimum of parameter sensitivity under exact reconstruction—whose attainment forces geometric alignment and unitarity of latent representations, thereby driving a canonical factorization model to favor functional compression (shared algebraic composition) over low-rank representations and to learn globally shared algebraic structures.
